# Orrery: AI Model Landing Page with Animated Product UI

Implemente a página conforme a demonstração original compilada incluída no pacote. Preserve composição, animações, responsividade e estados interativos. O código-fonte editável e os serviços de backend não foram recuperados nesta captura. Este prompt é uma instrução de reconstrução, não um prompt original do autor.

A light landing page for a made-up AI model company, with eleven animated Illos assets in the Interface style: a command bar in the hero, product cards, an answer that cites its sources and an agent that asks before it pays. They loop while in view and hold still under reduced motion. Plain HTML, CSS and JS with a small Node build and no dependencies. More animated assets at illos.dev.

    How it works

    Fast where it can be. Careful where it counts.

    Routed by difficulty

    Each request goes to the smallest model that can answer it well. The hard ones reach orrery-3.

    Answers that cite

    Orrery pulls the closest pages from your sources and marks each claim with where it came from.

    Asks before it acts

    Agents stop for a yes before they send, book or pay for anything, and show you exactly what they'll do.

    Infrastructure

    Trained and served on our own cluster.

    We own the racks, so we set the prices and the queue. No one else's demand slows your requests.

    Security

    Your data stays yours.

    Every customer runs in its own workspace, with its own keys. We never train on your prompts, files or answers, and you can delete them in one call.

    Retention
    Zero by default
